options.name: filter
options.description: Match facts to one of the specified patterns.

options.name: gather_subset
options.description: Specify or restrict the facts that are gathered. Possible values: V(all), V(database), V(elastic), V(license), V(rabbitmq), V(settings), V(system), V(threads). The minimum subset is: V(license), V(settings), V(system). To specify a specific subset, use V(!all, !min) and then specify the fact(s) required.

options.name: gather_timeout
options.description: Timeout period for collecting individual facts
